cocukEkle.title: Add your child
cocukEkle.desc: Create a code and have your child enter it in the Hupolingo app under Settings → Connect to parent. The code is valid for 24 hours and can be used once.

cocukEkle.copyError: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it manually.
cocukEkle.error: Could not create the code. Please try again shortly.
cocukEkle.webText: Your child can also use it on a computer:
cocukEkle.webLink: Open the student app on the web

cocuklarim.title: My children
cocuklarim.desc: Students linked to your account. You see study information only after you give consent to share it.

empty.title: No child linked yet

buHafta.tekrarNot: Topics answered incorrectly or due for review.
buHafta.bos: No study activity recorded this week yet.

weekly.title: Weekly Study
weekly.desc: Time spent and questions solved over the last 7 days
weekly.kaynak: Source: daily study records for the last 7 days (time and question count).
weekly.empty: No study activity recorded this week yet.
weekly.emptyNot: Daily study time will appear here once your child solves questions.

subjects.title: Success by Subject
subjects.desc: Distribution of solved questions by correct-answer rate

review.title: Review Suggestions
review.kaynak: Source: topics answered incorrectly or due for review. The rate is the share of correct answers for that topic.
review.subject: Subject
review.empty: No topics need review. Great job!

achievements.title: Badges
achievements.desc: Badges the student has earned and is working towards
achievements.xpNote: XP and level show progress inside the game; they do not measure learning level. For topic-level success, see the Subjects page.

membership.desc: Your subscription, plan, payment history and communication preferences.

plans.title: Paid plan

plans.preparing: A paid plan is in preparation. It will appear in this card once plans and prices are announced.

plans.paymentNote: You complete the payment with your card on the iyzico payment page.

subjectsPage.empty: No questions solved yet. Subject success will appear here once your child starts solving questions.

subjectsPage.topicsEmpty: No topics in this subject need review.

iletisimIzni.title: My communication preferences
iletisimIzni.text: We send you marketing messages by email only if you have clearly agreed to receive subscription, product and campaign information. You can withdraw your consent at any time; sign-in, password and security emails are not affected.
iletisimIzni.error: Your preference could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
iletisimIzni.loadError: Your preferences could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.

goalsPage.title: Daily Goals
goalsPage.desc: Your child's daily study goal and this week's completion
goalsPage.weeklyEmpty: No study sessions this week yet.

activityPage.title: Last 7 Days Activity
activityPage.kaynak: Source: daily study records for the last 7 days. The daily rate is shown on days with at least 6 solved questions.
activityPage.empty: No study sessions this week yet.
activityPage.emptyNot: The daily summary will appear here as your child solves questions.

consent.title: Use of Children's Data
consent.gate: The student's study data is shown after parental consent is given. You can give consent in the card below.
consent.notice: Parental consent is required before we can collect your child's study data.
consent.desc: The data is processed for educational purposes only, is never shared with third parties, and consent can be withdrawn at any time.
consent.ogretmenNotice: If your child has a teacher, the teacher sees only a class-level summary. The summary does not include names, email addresses or individual answers. Progress values are not shown when fewer than 3 students in the class have answered.
consent.error: The operation could not be completed.
consent.saveError: Consent could not be saved. Please try again.

abonelik.iptalNot: To cancel, contact our support team.
